source.note: The page's example success response — `{"ok": true, "url": "wss://wss-somethiing.slack.com/link/?ticket=12348&app_id=5678"}` — with the host, ticket and app id replaced by obviously fake ones (BD-002) — the host a subdomain of the replay binding's `slack.example.test`, as Slack's is of `slack.com`, because since WP-43 the adapter refuses a socket host that is not. The ticket is single-use and short-lived, so a real one would be a credential in the repository.
